summary.description: A white to brown flammable solid with a strong odour that evaporates easily.
environmental_impact: Carcinogenic to humans with harmful effects at elevated exposure levels
Toxic to wildlife and aquatic organisms at high concentrations
Breaks down easily in the environment, reducing long-term persistence

top_sdg_impacts.SDG3_Good_Health_and_Wellbeing: Naphthalene is carcinogenic and can cause severe health effects such as headaches, nausea, and coma at high exposure levels, posing risks to human health.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG11_Sustainable_Cities_and_Communities: Releases from fossil fuel burning and chemical industry contribute to urban pollution, affecting air quality and livability in cities.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG12_Responsible_Consumption_and_Produc: Use in mothballs, insecticides, and dyes, along with improper disposal, contributes to environmental pollution and calls for improved production and consumption practices.
